Dear [Miss Manning](/person/949)

[Miss Walter](/person/1462) and I have much enjoyed reading [Miss Lawrence](/person/2434)s' letter all the more as last Sunday evening [Mr Du Boulay](/person/446) kindly came and talked to the parish about Madagascar.[^1]

If you will let me know in time, I will send you [the Daisy Chain](/book/24), [Trial](/book/53) and [Pillars of the House](/book/109)to send to her.  I am very glad to have the pleasure of doing so

with many thanks

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: James du Boulay was a schoolmaster at Winchester College; he was married to a sister of the Bishop of Madagascar. The book dealer who sold the letter read it as \'Mrs du Boulay\', but it looks to me like Mr. Either is possible.
